tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the full text and metadata of one IWAC item by an id returned from `search` (format '<category>:<number>', e.g. 'articles:28576'). tools.name: explore_corpus

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search IWAC newspaper articles by keyword (title + OCR + AI abstracts, French and English), country, newspaper, subject, and date range. The press is French; English terms match only the English abstract. Matching is accent- and case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one article (by id): full metadata, the AI abstract (description_ai), AI sentiment, and OCR text, in 25k-char parts (follow `next_offset`). Pass a `keyword` to get ~2000-char excerpts around each match instead.

tools.name: semantic_search_articles
tools.description: Semantic search over article title + full text, including articles whose OCR is not public. Query in any language. Runs the corpus model, EmbeddingGemma 2, locally with no API key (first use downloads ~350 MB). similarity_score only ranks within one query.

tools.name: search_by_sentiment
tools.description: Filter articles by claude-haiku-5-5 sentiment labels (accent/case-insensitive exact match). tools.name: get_sentiment_distribution
tools.description: Aggregate AI labels over a shared selection. model:"all" compares independent annotators and their coverage; model:"consensus" reads the stored panel majority. compare_models and agreement_field give pairwise Cohen's kappa and quadratic weighted kappa, with explicit denominators. tools.name: search_index
tools.description: Search the IWAC authority index (persons, places, organisations, events, subjects) by name. Accent/case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_index_entry
tools.description: Get full details of an index entry by id (raw dataset columns, French names — Titre, Prénom, Coordonnées…).

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: List sujets from the IWAC index, sorted by frequency (most-referenced first).

tools.description: List lieux from the IWAC index, sorted by frequency (most-referenced first). tools.name: list_persons
tools.description: List personnes from the IWAC index, sorted by frequency (most-referenced first). The optional 'country' filter selects entries that APPEAR IN records from that country (mentioned-in, not located-in), ranked by collection-wide 'frequency' — so foreign and cross-border entries can appear. tools.name: get_collection_stats
tools.description: Overall statistics for every IWAC subset, including `fulltext_coverage` — how many items in each subset actually carry searchable full text in this dataset: a keyword count is a full-text census only within that coverage.

tools.name: get_newspaper_stats
tools.description: Per-newspaper article counts and date ranges.

tools.name: get_country_comparison
tools.description: Compare article counts, newspaper counts, date ranges, and claude-haiku-5-5 polarity across countries.

tools.name: get_temporal_distribution
tools.description: Counts by Gregorian or Hijri year/month, or pooled lunar month. Group by country/newspaper. Partial dates and missing lunar dates are disclosed. normalize_by returns numerator counts and per-bucket denominators in the same country/outlet/date scope, removing thematic filters. tools.name: get_topic_distribution
tools.description: Counts of offline LDA topic assignments, optionally over time. Topic labels are interpretive model outputs; exact topic_id filters select assignments rather than keyword matches. Reports unclassified coverage.

tools.name: get_field_distribution
tools.description: Rank exact metadata values, splitting pipe-separated tags. Reports missing metadata and optional coverage over time. Choose spatial for mentioned places, country for stored country tags, or subject/author/language.

tools.name: get_cooccurrence
tools.description: Count pairs of metadata values co-tagged on the same items. Matrix/network views show descriptive associations, not causal links. Filters apply before pair counting; top_n caps the vocabulary.

tools.name: get_place_distribution
tools.description: Place tags joined to authority coordinates. Separates publication countries from mentioned places; missing geocodes are counted explicitly.

tools.name: get_semantic_map
tools.description: Stable-hash sample of matching stored embeddings, projected with PCA. Reports eligible, invalid, missing and capped counts, seed and explained variance. Group counts describe the sample. Coordinates are chart-only; this is not the published UMAP landscape. Needs no API key.

tools.name: get_similar_items
tools.description: Nearest stored embeddings by cosine similarity. Articles and documents lead with the dataset's published top 10. tools.name: get_lexical_metrics
tools.description: Text length, lexical richness and readability by country/newspaper/year. Metrics are precomputed; readability is French-specific and excludes other languages. Missing values are disclosed. Distributions are descriptive evidence.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search Islamic publications (periodical issues, books). `keyword` matches title, subject, table of contents, and full OCR text (TOC hits come back as matching_toc_entries); publications are in French, so French terms are what match. Filter by newspaper/series, subject, country and year. Use list_per

tools.name: list_periodicals
tools.description: List the Islamic periodical/series titles in the publications subset, with issue counts and year ranges. Use the returned newspaper value as the `newspaper` filter on search_publications.

tools.name: get_publication_fulltext
tools.description: Full OCR text of a publication in 25k-char parts (follow `next_offset`), or ~2000-char excerpts around keyword matches (accent-insensitive; capped: see match_count vs excerpts_returned).

tools.name: semantic_search_publications
tools.description: Semantic search over publication tables of contents, present for ~40% of issues (none for An-Nasr Vendredi, 130 of 695 Islam Info issues): use search_publications for the rest. tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Full bibliographic record for one academic reference (by id), including the complete abstract (present for ~51% of references), subjects, DOI/URL, and host-work details (book, volume, issue, pages).

tools.name: semantic_search_references
tools.description: Semantic search over academic references by title + abstract, across languages. Only references with an abstract (about half) are covered; use search_references for the rest. Runs the corpus model, EmbeddingGemma 2, locally with no API key (first use downloads ~350 MB). similarity_score only ranks w

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search the small archival-documents subset (~26 items: Islamic association reports, flyers, project documents — mostly Burkina Faso). Documents are French; English terms match only the English AI description. Most have OCR text and an AI description. Call with no arguments to list all.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get one archival document (by id): full metadata, AI description, and OCR text, in 25k-char parts (follow `next_offset`). Pass a `keyword` to get ~2000-char excerpts around each match instead, useful for long documents.

tools.name: search_audiovisual
tools.description: Search audiovisual materials by keyword and metadata: francophone web video from Burkina Faso, Togo and Benin (TV reports, association and campus recordings), plus deposited Nigerian Hausa/Arabic recordings. tools.name: list_audiovisual

tools.name: get_audiovisual
tools.description: Get one audiovisual record by id: full description and transcription (where one exists), creator/publishing channel, duration, medium, subjects, places, language, rights, source, and three distinct links: `url` (the IWAC page, the one to cite), `external_url` (where a harvested video plays) and `med

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
